reason: An external-service integration plugin that adds OAuth authentication and model-provider inference access for Grok/xAI, Codex/ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Kimi Code.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Grok/xAI、Codex/ChatGPT、Claude Code 和 Kimi Code 的 OAuth 登录及模型推理服务接入。
summaries.en: Adds OAuth login and model inference access for Grok/xAI, Codex/ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Kimi Code to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Provides OAuth login flows for Grok/xAI, Codex/ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Kimi Code
Stores provider OAuth tokens in files under DSH_HOME/oauth
Routes inference requests to the listed external provider API endpoints
